Okay, how did Dark Watch pull this off while everyone else floundered?

Other than Space, Dark Watch has the best area damage of any team plus some of the highest number of ongoing destruction cards. Nightmist playing Mist form early and tanking all hits aimed at highest hero was a big factor. Eventually Setback and Harpy went down and used their incaps to give Expat and Fixer extra power uses.
Also, luck is a big factor. Freedom Five for example had great cards except for the fact that they couldn’t draw ongoing destruction and Maria Helena’s Revenge was played round 1.
